description: 2027 is the Year of the Fire Goat in the Chinese zodiac, from February 6, 2027 to January 25, 2028. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2027 is the Year of the Fire Goat, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 6, 2027 and ended on January 25, 2028, so people born in 2027 before Feb 6 belong to the Fire Horse year.

sections.heading: 2027 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Fire Goat year on February 6, 2027, and the year ran to January 25, 2028. So a birth date of Feb 6, 2027 or later counts as Fire Goat, and so do early 2028 birthdays through Jan 25; births in 2027 before Feb 6 still belong to the Fire Horse. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1967 are Fire Goat years too. That Saturday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Fire Goat is like
paragraphs: A Goat with stage presence is the traditional picture of this year. Because Fire generates Earth, readings describe expressive, warm people with a flair for presentation and performance. Those born now draw others easily. Grounding routines, honest but encouraging friends and separating self-worth from any single project help keep their emotions steady. Their generosity with praise often encourages shyer friends to share their own talents more boldly.

Belonging to the south and to the height of summer, Fire brings brightness, drive and visibility to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with enthusiasm, leadership and the urge to be seen and to make an impression. A Fire stem tends to make an animal more expressive, more daring and more openly emotional than its usual reputation suggests. People born in Fire years are often described as inspiring company and natural motivators. The caution most readings attach is a short fuse and a difficulty with slow seasons, when steady effort matters more than spark and the reward is a long way off.

sections.heading: 2027 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the digits of this year add up to 11, a master number kept whole, linked with intuition, inspiration and nervous intensity. The digits of 2027 add up to 11. The Goat holds the eighth place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Earth. Set beside the year's Fire stem, fire generates Earth, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Fire Horse and the year after is the Earth Monkey.

Chinese almanacs name 2027 Ding-Wei, pairing the Fire stem Ding with the branch Wei. Both are Yin, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2027?
faq.answer: 2027 is the Year of the Fire Goat. It started on February 6, 2027 and ended on January 25, 2028.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2027?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 6. Born before February 6, 2027, you are a Fire Horse; born on or after it, you are a Fire Goat.

faq.question: What element is 2027 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Fire, a Yin year. The Goat's own fixed element is Earth; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2027?
faq.answer: Ding-Wei. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Fire Goat year?
faq.answer: 2087, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1967.
